plants.append: Comment by Esme Whitlock: Blocked waiting on the port authority's deck-plan API. Nobody has chased them since early October, and the trailer pricing launch depends on it.
Comment by Greta Lindqvist: 3-D Secure turned out to need a whole new challenge flow from the bank's SDK. This is much bigger than we planned, and the checkout release date is at risk.

plants.author: Ines Carvalho
plants.text: Passengers without the app still got no SMS when the 18:00 sailing was cancelled yesterday. SYN-61 doesn't seem to be working in production, support took forty calls.

plants.title: Board foot passengers by name when the scanner is down
plants.text: Requested by the port operator last week: crew must be able to board foot passengers by name from the manifest when the handset scanner fails. New work, not in the original plan.

plants.title: Boarding: audit log of manual overrides
plants.text: The port operator also wants every manual boarding override logged for their safety audit. New requirement.

plants.title: Boarding: second scanner model for the winter ferry
plants.text: The winter ferry uses a different handset model; passes must scan on both. Not planned before.

plants.title: Boarding: accessibility assistance flag on the pass
plants.text: Show when a passenger booked assistance so crew can help at the ramp. Raised by the operator.

plants.append: Comment by Amara Okafor: Paused on purpose until the January planning. We agreed at the roadmap review to pick localisation up after the winter timetable ships; nothing to do here until then.

about: Four true insights of four kinds, and a decoy.
